newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac plans to raise A$500 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac plans to raise A$500 mln.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp said on Wednesday that it plans to raise up to A$500 million through a preference share issue.

Westpac said it would issue up to 20 million non-cumulative converting preference share at an issue price of A$25 each. The funds raised would be used to fund the cash component under the Bank of Melbourne Ltd merger scheme, it said.
It said the preference shares would carry a fixed dividend subject to profits being available for distribution twice a year and subject to capital adequacy compliance.

The bank said the shares would convert into a number of Westpac ordinary shares by dividing the CPS issue price by the greater of A$1.00 and 95 percent of the market price average over 20 days prior to conversion date.
Westpac earlier reported a 12.9 percent rise in net profit after abnormal items to A$638 million for the six months ended March 31.
